## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests (new test files are listed in `package.json`)
- [ ] Ran `npm run inventory` and `npm run doctor` if skills, agents, `registry.json` or `hub.config.json` changed; `npm run guide` if docs changed
- [ ] User-visible text is in `i18n/en.json`
- [ ] No personal data or secrets (names, e-mails, paths, tokens)
- [ ] No new npm dependency
